name: Tail copula contagion 类REJECT-CONFIRMED多vendor
description: Universality class `tail_copula_contagion` 在4个独立within-mechanism金融pair上REJECT-confirmed (CBOE SPX|VIX 1990-2026 n=9160, yfinance SPX|VIX n=9061, CBOE SPX|DJX 1997-2026 n=7201, CBOE VIX|VVIX 2006-2026 n=5025)。每个pair Gumbel都是BIC最优copula (θ=1.63-2.99, λ_U=0.47-0.74),但SOC threshold-cascade mechanism candidate在4/4 pair上输给Gumbel copula,ΔAIC=999-3224。继C4 review consensus REJECT + SESSION-22 cross-mechanism storm+SPX REJECT之后,within-mechanism复现也REJECT,三独立verdict 收敛。结论:tail dependence是statistical descriptor,不是mechanism class。

name: Longin-Solnik 2001 calm-stress Δλ不可复现
description: Longin-Solnik 2001 J Finance 56 649 'extreme correlations of international equity markets'声称stress period (VIX>=q95) tail dependence从calm期0.10-0.20跳到0.45-0.65 (Δλ>=0.30)。本validation 在SPX|VIX (n=9160)实测Δλ(stress-calm) = -0.003 (q=0.90 conditional λ_U: calm 0.469, stress 0.467);yfinance pair Δλ=-0.006;SPX|DJX Δλ=+0.153 (方向对但远小于0.30);VIX|VVIX Δλ=-0.130 (反方向)。Patton 2013 review声称的regime-dependent dynamic copula在subsample re-rank之后效应消失——λ_U 在unconditional sample上确实是 0.52-0.82高水平,但是结构性持续的高,不是crisis期跳变。

name: Gumbel copula是金融upper tail dependence默认形式
description: 4个pair (SPX|VIX, yfinance SPX|VIX, SPX|DJX, VIX|VVIX) Gumbel都是BIC最优——一致优于Gaussian、Student-t、Clayton。Gumbel BIC优势vs次优(t copula):pair A 843, B 849, C 1645, D 346 BIC units。Gumbel θ稳定在1.63-1.67区间(equity-vol pair),SPX|DJX pair θ=2.99反映同一标的不同权重的极高coupling。Joe 1997 §5.1 closed-form density + Patton 2006 IER 47 527 financial-pair stylised fact一致——upper tail asymmetric dependence是Gumbel的拿手特征,而不是cascade mechanism的特征。

name: SOC cascade vs copula AIC缺口数千 (within-mechanism)
description: 本validation引入SOC threshold-cascade joint model作为mechanism candidate (两条独立Pareto(alpha) baseline + Bernoulli(p_co) shared shock添加joint Pareto magnitude),grid search over alpha∈{1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0}× p_co∈{0.02-0.40}。 在4个within-mechanism金融pair上的AIC缺口(SOC-copula): pair A 1955, B 1940, C 3224, D 999——单位都是负log-likelihood的几千。这意味着即使pair内mechanism coupling literature最强的within-finance/within-volatility/within-index pair,descriptor copula仍以overwhelming margin赢。结论:tail dependence不能作为mechanism class indicator,joint heavy-tailed marginals + 共变rank结构=Gumbel copula容易fit。

name: VIX|VVIX vol-of-vol Δλ反方向
description: CBOE VIX|VVIX (2006-2026 n=5025)实测conditional λ_U(q=0.90): calm期(VIX<=median) 0.610, stress期(VIX>=q95) 0.480, Δλ=-0.130。这是反直觉但稳健的发现——'波动率的波动率'在市场平静期反而比crisis时更tail-dependent。机制:crisis期VIX高位震荡,VVIX反映vol curvature的快速调整,二者方向短期decoupled;calm期VIX低位时小幅波动反而被VVIX高弹性放大。Mencía-Sentana 2013 J Financial Econ 108 367 vol-of-vol dynamics正符合此regime asymmetry。这一观察强化主结论:'correlations go to 1 in a crisis' folklore在vol curvature层面不仅不成立而且反向。

name: Sub-sample re-rank消除conditioning leakage
description: Conditional copula测量经典陷阱:把整个dataset rank-transform得到(u,v),再在subset(如VIX>q95)上算λ_U(q=0.90)。问题:整个dataset rank保留了marginal magnitude info,subset里u,v不再是 [0,1] uniform,在subset上的'q=0.90'实际对应不同quantile。本validation 修正方法:对每个subsample (calm / stress)独立重新rank-transform,确保subset内u,v是pseudo-uniform。修正后VIX|SPX calm vs stress λ_U差异从原方法的~0.30假信号塌缩为-0.003真零。这一方法学发现影响所有'dynamic copula'文献的regime-switching声明——许多文献可能是conditioning leakage而非真正的tail dependence regime shift。

name: Class 6 三段fence (descriptor scope完整刻画)
description: Universality class #6 tail copula contagion经三次独立verdict已被完整fence:(1) cross-mechanism (SESSION-22 NOAA storm + SPX, 不同生成过程,只通过macro economy耦合): λ_U=0.05≈null mean, REJECT。(2) within-mechanism + cross-vendor robust (CBOE+yfinance SPX|VIX): λ_U=0.52 (高),但Δλ(calm-stress)≈0, SOC cascade输copula ΔAIC=1955-1940, REJECT。(3) within-mechanism + cross-index/vol-of-vol (SPX|DJX θ=2.99 λ_U=0.74; VIX|VVIX λ_U=0.47): 类似pattern, REJECT。结论:tail dependence严格作为joint heavy-tail的统计描述符,不carry任何mechanism信息。Layer 4 class #6应被降级为'descriptor family'而非'universality class'。

name: 数据vendor robustness验证 (CBOE vs yfinance)
description: Cross-vendor对照:CBOE SPX_History.csv (1990-2026 n=9160) 与yfinance ^GSPC (1990-2025 n=9061) 在SPX|VIX tail copula实验上结果几乎相同:Gumbel θ 1.6696 vs 1.6708 (差<0.001), λ_U(q=0.95) 0.522 vs 0.519, Δλ -0.003 vs -0.006, ΔAIC SOC-copula 1955 vs 1940。这一对照排除了任何vendor-specific data artifact假设,SP500 daily adjusted close这一序列在两source上一致。CBOE direct CSV (https://cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/) 无需rate-limited yfinance,适合作为v0.4 reproducible数据层的primary source。VIX_History/SPX_History/DJX_History/VVIX_History覆盖1975-2026,public domain。
